tiktok_shop_affiliate_commission_pct.label: ESTIMATED
tiktok_shop_affiliate_commission_pct.source: Common range 10% to 25% (hamstergarage.com); pet median 13.1% across selling videos (hubfluence.io, vendor, Nov 2026)

store_conversion_rate.label: ESTIMATED
store_conversion_rate.source: No benchmark exists for creator-referred traffic (UNKNOWN). Proxy: Meta click-to-purchase for Pets 1.60%, Triple Whale via research/fast-test-2026-11-21/04_reality_and_benchmarks.md

views_per_small_creator_post.label: ESTIMATED
views_per_small_creator_post.source: Views per video for creators under about 5k followers (Socialinsider via hubfluence.io); Buffer's 11.4M-post study puts median views near 500 at every posting frequency

paid_post_fee_usd.label: ESTIMATED
paid_post_fee_usd.source: Collabstr pet listings and averages from search snippets; the skeptic could not confirm today's prices (pages blocked), so treat as unverified. Insense nano sponsored posts start at $125 (VERIFIED) but need a $1,500 a quarter plan.

gifting_post_rate.label: ESTIMATED
gifting_post_rate.source: Share of gifted creators who post, 20% to 40% (skeepers.io, vendor); 61% of marketers say fewer than half post (Traackr survey, 2023)

link_click_rate_scenarios.label: ASSUMED
link_click_rate_scenarios.source: Share of a post's viewers who click through to the store. No credible public benchmark was found (01_creator_economics.md), so three scenarios are shown.

reference_meta_cac_usd.label: ESTIMATED
reference_meta_cac_usd.source: Meta Pets benchmark cost per purchase, Triple Whale Nov 2025 to Oct 2026
